messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 我目前無法直接查詢實時交通資訊。若您能告訴我要查詢哪個地點（例如街道、交叉口或地址），我可以先幫您定位該位置，之後再協助尋找相關交通資料。

Actually we might want to get traffic data. But the only tool available is geocode_address. That transforms a description of a location to a location on Earth. It doesn't provide traffic info. So we cannot answer directly. We can ask clarifying question: maybe they want traffic in NYC. We could respond with a request for clarification or say we don't have real-time traffic data. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we can politely say we can't provide real-time traffic. Or we can ask if they'd like us to geocode a specific address. But the question is about traffic. We can ask them to specify a location or address. But we can also mention that we don't have real-time traffic data. So best approach: ask for clarification: "Could you specify which part of New York or which address you'd like traffic info for?" Also note we can't provide real-time traffic.
